standards.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - General Requirements
standards.scope: Covers safety requirements for household and similar electrical appliances with rated voltage not exceeding 250V for single-phase and 480V for other appliances.
standards.key_requirements: Protection against access to live parts, proper insulation resistance, dielectric strength, temperature limits, moisture resistance, leakage current limits under operating temperature.

standards.title: Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and including 1100V
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for single and multicore PVC insulated cables for electric power and lighting in domestic, commercial, and industrial installations.
standards.key_requirements: Conductor resistance limits, minimum PVC insulation thickness, oxygen index testing, flame retardancy behavior, thermal stability.

standards.title: Residual Current Operated Circuit Breakers (RCCBs) without Integral Overcurrent Protection
standards.scope: Applies to residual current operated circuit breakers functionally independent of, or functionally dependent on, line voltage, for household and similar uses.
standards.key_requirements: Minimum residual operating current of 30mA for personal protection, tripping times within specified milliseconds, clear trip state indication, test button functionality.

standards.title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water)
standards.scope: Prescribes physical, chemical, and microbiological requirements, along with testing methodologies, for packaged drinking water filled in hermetically sealed containers.
standards.key_requirements: Total dissolved solids (TDS) between 75-500 mg/l, pH level between 6.5-8.5, zero detection of E.coli and coliform bacteria, maximum limits for heavy metals (lead, arsenic, mercury).

standards.title: Processed Cereal-Based Complementary Foods for Infants
standards.scope: Prescribes requirements and methods of test for processed cereal-based complementary foods intended for feeding infants as a complement to breast milk or infant formula.
standards.key_requirements: Minimum protein content of 15% by mass, moisture max 5%, maximum ash content, minimum energy density of 4 kcal/g, enrichment with essential vitamins and minerals.

standards.title: Milk Powder - Specification
standards.scope: Prescribes requirements, methods of sampling, and test for milk powder obtained by spray drying or roller drying.
standards.key_requirements: Moisture content not exceeding 4.0% for spray-dried and 5.0% for roller-dried milk powder, minimum milk protein in solids, max solubility index, bacterial plate count limits.

standards.title: Textiles - Polyester Blend Shirting and Suiting - Specification
standards.scope: Prescribes physical and chemical requirements for polyester-blend shirting and suiting fabrics, including polyester-cotton and polyester-viscose blends.
standards.key_requirements: Polyester blend composition percentage tolerance of +/- 3%, minimum breaking strength, colorfastness to light, washing, rubbing, and perspiration, dimensional change (shrinkage) limits of max 2%.

standards.title: Specification for Cotton Fabric for Umbrellas
standards.scope: Prescribes constructional details and other requirements of cotton fabrics used in the manufacture of umbrellas.
standards.key_requirements: High water repellency rating, threads per dm (ends and picks), mass per square meter, minimum breaking strength, scoured water-soluble matter limits.

standards.title: Cotton Sewing Threads - Specification
standards.scope: Prescribes requirements of cotton sewing threads, bleached or dyed, wound on spools, cones, or tubes.
standards.key_requirements: Single thread breaking strength, length per unit spool, count of yarn, twist direction and plies, colorfastness to washing and bleaching.

chunks.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - General Requirements
chunks.section_name: Clause 8: Protection against access to live parts
chunks.content: Appliances shall be constructed and enclosed so that there is adequate protection against accidental contact with live parts. This applies for all positions of the appliance when it is operated as in normal use, and after the removal of detachable parts. The test finger of Clause 8.1.1 is applied in every possible position to check for contact.

chunks.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - General Requirements
chunks.section_name: Clause 13: Leakage current and electric strength at operating temperature
chunks.content: At operating temperature, the leakage current of the appliance shall not be excessive and its dielectric strength shall be adequate. For Class I portable appliances, the leakage current limit is 0.75 mA. For Class II appliances, the leakage current limit is 0.25 mA. High voltage test is applied at 1000V to 3750V depending on insulation type.

chunks.title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water)
chunks.content: Packaged drinking water must comply with the following chemical properties: Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) must be between 75 mg/l and 500 mg/l. The pH value of the water must be in the range of 6.5 to 8.5. Turbidity must not exceed 2 NTU. Total hardness as CaCO3 must not exceed 200 mg/l.

chunks.title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water)
chunks.content: Microbiological safety limits for packaged drinking water are absolute: Escherichia coli (E. coli) must be absent in any 250 ml sample. Coliform bacteria must be absent in any 250 ml sample. Yeast and Mould spores must be absent in any 250 ml sample. Total viable colony count at 37 degrees Celsius must not exceed 100 per ml.

chunks.title: Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) Insulated Cables for Voltages up to 1100V
chunks.section_name: Clause 14: Spark Test and High Voltage Test
chunks.content: Cables must undergo spark testing and high voltage testing to ensure structural insulation safety. In spark testing, the cable core is passed through an electrode field with a voltage between 3kV and 10kV AC depending on cable size. High voltage test requires the finished cable to withstand a voltage of 3kV AC applied for 5 minutes without breakdown.

chunks.title: Textiles - Polyester Blend Shirting and Suiting - Specification
chunks.content: The blend composition of polyester-cotton and polyester-viscose fabrics must match the declared values with a tolerance limit of +/- 3%. For example, a 67% Polyester and 33% Cotton blend fabric must have a polyester content between 64% and 70%. Fiber content is checked using chemical dissolution methods specified in IS 3416.

chunks.title: BIS Product Certification Scheme (ISI Mark)
chunks.content: To obtain an ISI Mark licence, manufacturers must submit an application on Form V along with an application fee of INR 1000. Under Option 1 (Normal Procedure), a preliminary inspection of the factory is conducted by a BIS officer to verify testing infrastructure. Samples are drawn for testing in independent labs. Under Option 2 (Simplified Procedure), the manufacturer gets samples tested in advance and submits the report with the application, reducing processing time.

chunks.title: BIS Product Certification Scheme (ISI Mark)
chunks.content: The Government of India has made BIS certification mandatory for certain products in public interest, safety, and health through Quality Control Orders (QCOs). Currently, mandatory categories include: 1. Milk powder and infant foods, 2. Packaged drinking water, 3. Household electrical appliances (like irons, geysers, food mixers), 4. Cement and steel products, 5. Toys, and 6. Direct-use batteries.

chunks.title: Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme (FMCS)
chunks.content: The Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme (FMCS) allows foreign manufacturers to use the ISI mark on their products imported into India. Applications must be submitted directly to the BIS FMCS Department in New Delhi. The manufacturer must bear the costs of the factory audit, including travel and lodging of the BIS auditor, testing fees, and annual license fees. A local representative in India must be appointed to act as a contact point.

chunks.title: BIS Gold and Silver Jewellery Hallmarking
chunks.section_name: Section 1: Components of a Valid Hallmark
chunks.content: A valid BIS Hallmark on gold jewellery consists of three specific marks: 1. The BIS Logo (triangular shape), 2. Purity in Carats and Fineness (e.g. 22K916 for 22 carat, 18K750 for 18 carat), and 3. Six-digit alphanumeric HUID (Hallmark Unique Identification) code. HUID is unique to each individual jewellery article and can be verified using the official BIS CARE mobile application.

chunks.title: BIS CARE Mobile Application Guidelines
chunks.section_name: Section 2: Verification of ISI Mark and HUID
chunks.content: Consumers can protect themselves from counterfeit goods using the BIS CARE mobile app: 1. To verify an ISI Mark, enter the 7-to-11 digit Licence Number (R-number) printed on the product. 2. To verify Hallmark gold jewellery, enter the 6-digit HUID code. The app will display details of the manufacturer, licence status, validity, and product specifications instantly. If details do not match, a complaint can be filed immediately through the app.

chunks.title: Filing Complaints against Substandard Products
chunks.section_name: Section 4: How to Register a Complaint
chunks.content: If you purchase a product with a fake ISI mark, or find a certified product is of sub-standard quality, you can register a formal complaint with BIS: 1. Use the 'Complaints' tab in the BIS CARE App or visit the BIS portal. 2. Provide the dealer's invoice, the ISI licence number (if present), photographs of the product, and a brief description of the defect. BIS will investigate, conduct surprise audits at the factory, and take legal action or cancel the license if violations are found. Complainants receive feedback on investigation progress.
